newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Trading in Seyang shares halted -bourse.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Seyang shares halted -bourse.

text.p: Trading in shares of Seyang Shipping Co Ltd was halted until Thursday due to the company's announcement it was considering applying for court receivership, the Korea Stock Exchange said on Wednesday.

Seyang said in a statement it was considering seeking court receivership or looking for a buyer as it faced financial trouble. The company said it would announce by Thursday whether to apply for court receivership.
Seyang shares last traded at 7,050 won, down 450 won.
